dense_sm90_general_fallback.name: dense SM90 general fallback
dense_sm90_general_fallback.logical_traffic_definition: half-precision all-gather plus reduce-scatter over tokens times hidden times expert-parallel width elements
dense_sm90_general_fallback.external_pricing_definition: opaque eight-rank NCCL table measurement scaled by the donor rank factor, with no source, destination, path or message ledger
dense_sm90_general_fallback.packet_pricing_definition: dense half-precision operation-buffer coordinate priced by the landed aggregate all-gather and reduce-scatter floor authority, each floor charged once outside the maximum of calibrated local byte-slope service and synchronized direct all-pairs fabric service over the declared Clos placement
dense_sm90_general_fallback.superseded_packet_pricing_definition: dense half-precision element count expanded as synchronized direct all-pairs transfers over the declared Clos placement, with intra-node collective transport and fixed collective overheads omitted

dense_sm90_general_fallback.external_message_argument_interpretation: the caller passes tokens times hidden times expert-parallel width as an element count; the calibration study proved that the raw table coordinate is ELEMENTS despite the message_bytes interpolation label, and converts it to true bytes using the dtype width

sparse_routed_payload.name: sparse routed expert payload
sparse_routed_payload.logical_traffic_definition: top-k token assignments routed only to realized expert-owner ranks, with FP8 dispatch and BF16 combine

sparse_routed_payload.packet_pricing_definition: realized sparse packet fabric service composed with acknowledged transferred all-gather and reduce-scatter aggregate floors and byte slopes at the logical FP8 dispatch and BF16 combine operation-buffer coordinates
sparse_routed_payload.superseded_packet_pricing_definition: realized sparse packet transfers with intra-node collective transport and fixed collective overheads omitted
